items.title: Gordon Lorraine — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I fell under his spell... That’s how I fell in love with Thelonious and his music... So we recorded him and recorded him

ctx.x: You credit Ike Quebec with introducing you to Thelonious Monk.

Well, yeah. I credit Ike with lots of things. Yes, he was a good friend. And yes, he did. He literally took us by the hand and said, “I want you to meet...” We didn’t know Thelonious Monk, quite honestly. I didn’t. If Alfred did, he sure didn’t tell me. He didn’t know him. He took us to his apartment in Hell’s Kitchen...at the time. Now it’s so fancy, you can’t live there. Hell’s Kitchen, on East 65th, I believe [sic: East 63rd], in a brownstone...a tenement, not a brownstone... A tenement building on the left…
Is that near where Lincoln Center is?
